hook.line: Most people get this wrong. Up 40%, then down 25%?
hook.voice: Most people miss this one. Will you?

question_voice: A price jumps up, then drops back down. We want the change overall.
signature_move: Turn each percent change into a multiplier.

steps.voice: Turn each change into a multiplier. Up forty percent means times one point four.
Down twenty-five percent means times zero point seven five.
Multiply them, and you get one point zero five.

answer.voice: One point zero five means a five percent increase. That's A. Quick check: start at a hundred dollars. Up to one hundred forty, then down to one hundred five.

trap.summary: Subtracting the percents, 40 − 25 = 15%, when the 25% comes off the higher price.
notepad: the 25% is off the NEW price
trap.voice: Here's where people slip. They just subtract, forty minus twenty-five, and say fifteen percent. That's C. But the drop comes off the new, higher price.

takeaway: Percent changes multiply; they don't add.
